description: This file defines a Java entity class named Role used in a persistence context, representing roles within an application with fields for id, name, and maxContractValue.

classes.name: Role
classes.description: An entity representing a user role with a unique name and an optional maximum contract value, used within a persistence context.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the role.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the role.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the role.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the role.

methods.name: getMaxContractValue
methods.description: Returns the maximum contract value allowed for this role.

methods.name: setMaxContractValue
methods.description: Sets the maximum contract value for this role.
